facts.fact: Ch 17 aligns its counts to day twenty of the bond: Kunal has watched Ila's hands and field book for twenty days. Thirty-five days is the Meadow Cairn meltwater, when the bond ends; the Shilak thaw council follows about three weeks later in a hard year (per F435, F622). Flag F512 (six days roped at ch 13) for an S7 ruling against day twenty at ch 17.
